title: Remove hero section image from homepage

requirements.summary: Remove the image element from the Hero component while preserving all other functionality and content
acceptanceCriteria: The image element at the specified XPath is no longer rendered in the Hero component
The Hero component layout adjusts gracefully without the removed image
No broken image references or console errors occur

file_operations.description: Remove the image element (likely an tag) that displays the hero background or logo image. Adjust the component's JSX structure to remove the image container div and its child img element. Ensure the remaining content (IBAZEX logo text, Arabic tagline, WhatsApp contact info, and feature cards) maintains proper layout and spacing without the image. Verify that no image-related props, imports, or className references remain that would cause console errors.
